manifest.name: gdn-fp8-mid24-35-unsloth-mlp0-27-lmhead
manifest.description: FP8 on the recurrent band 24-35 of the shipped map (as in gdn-fp8-mid24-35-lmhead-q4k), with the attested calibrated NVFP4 bytes (unsloth) on MLP layers 0-27 only. Across all of layers 0-55 those bytes help maths but cost code, long context and multilingual drift, which is why V13 earns nothing; measured by section, the early half keeps most of the maths gain while long, code, general and multilingual drift all stay below the band alone. They are NVFP4 like the shipped bytes, so kernels, prefill, decode and memory stay those of the band recipe. Attention, the other recurrent layers and MLP layers 28-63 keep the shipped bytes; lm_head is stored BF16 so its batch-1 Q4_K is fitted once from the original weights.
